summary: Evidence-backed clarifications for AI Evaluation Field Guide.

items.title: Module 5, dataset splits
items.whatChanged: Evaluate the full data mixture alongside its individual sources.
items.why: An interaction can be absent from isolated source checks.

sources.title: Clean data can strengthen a backdoor in a mixture

items.title: Module 9, the adversarial loop
items.whatChanged: Declare adaptive test limits and repeat policy before testing.
items.why: Results depend on access, feedback and budget.

sources.title: Robustness depends on adaptive attacker budget

items.title: Module 10, evaluating agent workflows
items.whatChanged: Measure team results and individual actions under shared constraints.
items.why: A group result can conceal unhealthy behavior by one participant.

sources.title: Multi-user multi-agent teams can fail as a group

items.title: Module 12, production monitoring
items.whatChanged: Revalidate detection when the model or reasoning settings change.
items.why: Proxy scores and readable traces alone offer limited evidence about detection.
